jobs.title: Senior Technology Director, Applied Research Science, AI/ML
jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Enterprise Data & AI organization is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and services that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, AI-driven data analytics and insights, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, while embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency.

The Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Research team is specifically responsible for exploring, developing, and advancing cutting-edge AI capabilities that will transform lululemon’s future business growth. This team operates at the intersection of research and application—identifying emerging technologies, building new models, and translating complex business challenges into scalable AI-driven algorithms.

Core Responsibilities

As a Senior Director, AI/ML Research and Science, you are accountable for advancing lululemon’s AI capabilities through the research, development, and delivery of innovative AI models and solutions that drive measurable business impact. This ole requires innovation at the intersection of solving complex business problems and extending the state-of-the-art to achieve high-performing AI solutions that transform the business.

Reporting to senior technology leadership, you will lead a lean, highly specialized team of AI research and applied scientists focused on pushing the boundaries of applied AI, balancing forward-looking exploration (3–5 years out) with near-term business aspect.

This role serves as a critical bridge between state-of-the-art AI research and enterprise business problems, translating evolving business needs into novel solutions and shaping the enterprise AI research roadmap in partnership with business stakeholders.

Select Responsibilities Include

AI Research & Innovation

Define and drive a forward-looking AI research roadmap (3–5-year horizon) aligned to business priorities
Explore emerging technologies, methods, and models to unlock future capabilities
Lead the design, development, and optimization of complex AI/ML models.

Business Problem Solving

Translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions
Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify high-impact use cases
Ensure research outputs are aligned with tangible business outcomes

Strategy & Influence

Provide expert guidance that shapes the broader AI/ML research strategy
Act as a thought leader across the organization in AI innovation
Contribute to establishing lululemon’s AI capabilities as a competitive advantage

Partnership & Delivery

Collaborate closely with AI Platform and Data teams to productionize solutions
Ensure research innovations can be effectively integrated into business operations
Balance experimentation with scalable, practical implementation

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of AI/ML research scientists
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning
Build an inclusive, collaborative environment aligned with lululemon’s values

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in AI/ML, with a strong emphasis on research and innovation
Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field with a strong publication record in peer-reviewed conferences and journals.
Proven experience leading technical research teams in industry or academia
Deep expertise in modern AI/ML techniques (e.g., deep learning, NLP, generative AI, optimization)
Track record of developing novel models, frameworks, or applied research solutions
Experience translating research into real-world business applications
Strong collaboration experience with engineering and data platform teams

must haves

Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Additional Notes

Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from  $223,500 - $293,350

; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Associate Director, Generative AI and Agentic AI Architecture

About The Role

As an Associate Director, Generative AI and Agentic AI Architecture, you will make an impact by shaping and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across strategic client accounts. You will be a valued member of Cognizant’s AI leadership team and work collaboratively with client executives, Sales, Presales, Delivery, Engineering, and Data Science teams.

In this highly visible role, you will combine hands-on AI architecture expertise with executive advisory, solution delivery, practice development, and technical leadership.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent AI solutions across multiple client engagements.
Advise CXO-level stakeholders, facilitate executive workshops and AI maturity assessments, and translate complex AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and adoption roadmaps.
Define scalable reference architectures, technical standards, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and governance for production AI systems integrated with enterprise applications, data platforms, and cloud environments.
Develop repeatable AI offerings, accelerators, reusable components, and intellectual property while supporting proposals, RFPs, solution estimates, and account growth opportunities.
Build and mentor high-performing teams of AI architects, engineers, and data scientists while promoting responsible AI, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Canada. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, combined with extensive progressive experience in AI/ML architecture, consulting, and delivery leadership.
Proven experience architecting and delivering production-grade Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and Agentic AI solutions using large language models, small language models, and orchestration frameworks.
Hands-on expertise with Python, model APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, agentic workflows, embedding models, vector databases, reranking, hybrid search, and retrieval architectures.
Experience integrating AI solutions with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, along with containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLOps, LLMOps, security, monitoring, and enterprise governance practices.
Strong client-facing leadership and executive communication skills, including experience advising senior stakeholders, leading complex AI engagements, developing proposals and statements of work, and managing globally distributed teams.

These will help you stand out

A PhD, MBA, or advanced credential in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or business management.
Published research, patents, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or recognized thought leadership in Generative AI, Agentic AI, natural language processing, or LLMOps.
Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Google Agent Development Kit, as well as AgentOps, model evaluation, and AI observability platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI, enterprise data governance, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act, and emerging AI regulatory requirements.
Consulting experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail, Manufacturing, or Technology.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applicants will be accepted till 11/15/2026

Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.

Please note, this role cannot offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future*

The annual salary for this position will be in the range of $152,000 - $170,000 CAD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing software-as-a-service (SaaS) company, is looking for an innovative, hands-on VP of Finance to join their leadership team and help support this exciting next stage of growth. Reporting to the President and CEO, the Vice President of Finance will lead financial operations, strengthen financial planning and provide trusted business insights to the executive leadership team. This is a terrific opportunity for a highly capable, hands-on financial executive who combines excellent accounting and operational expertise with strong business judgement and strategic thinking. Working closely with the Controller and finance team, you will take full ownership of financial reporting, operational finance, forecasting, cash management, and financial controls. You will also act as an important business partner, helping leadership make sound decisions about investments, profitability and growth. Key responsibilities include:

Lead the finance function and work closely with the Controller to deliver accurate, timely financial reporting, including monthly, quarterly, and annual close, financial statements, audits, and regulatory compliance
Maintain sound technical accounting policies and standards (including revenue recognition), with strong discipline over cash, working capital, billing, collections, and spending
Strengthen financial systems, processes, and controls to support efficient operations and growth
Own budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial models, and cash flow planning
Provide management with clear analysis of performance, trends, and risks, and develop key metrics such as recurring revenue, retention, margins, and customer economics
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other leaders to improve financial visibility and evaluate investments against expected returns
Serve as a trusted financial partner to the CEO and executive team, and prepare reporting and insights for the Board and investors
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team

If you are an accomplished finance leader who enjoys combining financial discipline with business leadership, and would like to help shape the future of an innovative AI-driven technology company – apply today!

Qualifications:

The main qualifications for this role include:

CPA designation or equivalent professional accounting qualification
Significant progressive experience in accounting and finance, including leadership responsibility in a growing technology, software or recurring-revenue business
Deep knowledge of financial accounting, technical accounting standards, reporting, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting and cash management
Familiarity with the financial and operational challenges of scaling a technology company including the evolution of financial systems, reporting, controls, forecasting and business performance management
Experience with technology business models, subscription, recurring-revenue and the related planning and performance metrics
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial data into clear, actionable business recommendations
Demonstrated ability to manage and develop a finance team while fostering a positive culture

How You Will Be Rewarded:

jobs.title: Director, Developer Platform and AI Transformation
jobs.description:
About Verily Health Inc.

At the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily Health transforms complex health data into trusted intelligence, enabling health solutions that are more personal, predictive, and precise.

Verily’s flagship Governed Health Intelligence platform, Verily Pre, enables healthcare organizations to responsibly govern, model, and securely activate their protected health data at scale, deploying intelligence with the scientific rigor, oversight, and auditability needed for healthcare.

Description

The Director of Developer Platform and AI Transformation will lead Verily’s developer platform and enterprise AI enablement strategy. In this role, you will own the tools and infrastructure that enable engineers to build and release software securely and efficiently, and you will drive the adoption of AI across engineering and business functions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cloud Engineering and Developer Platform, you will lead a high-performing organization of 15 engineers and managers. You will be accountable for developers productivity, AI enablement, and the return on Verily’s AI investments.

Responsibilities

Developer Platform

Own the end-to-end SDLC toolchain, including GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and build and release pipelines, along with foundational developer services such as identity and access management (Okta).
Manage the developer platform as an internal product, using developer research and productivity data to improve the developer experience, set priorities, and guide the roadmap.
Ensure the reliability, observability, and cost efficiency of CI/CD and core developer tooling against defined service-level objectives.
Partner with Security and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) teams to secure the software supply chain and maintain auditable pipelines that meet Verily’s regulatory requirements (such as FISMA and FedGov).
Integrate AI across the SDLC, including coding agents, code review, testing, and deployment, supported by the necessary security, privacy, and cost guardrails.

AI Transformation

Define and execute Verily’s enterprise AI enablement strategy and roadmap, and manage the portfolio of internal and third-party AI solutions, including build-versus-buy decisions.
Partner with operations, finance, legal, and product engineering leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, and lead the redesign of those workflows using AI agents.
Build and operate a shared AI harness encompassing agentic platform, MCP integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise knowledge graph.
Establish AI governance in partnership with Security, Privacy, Legal, and GRC, covering acceptable use, protected health information, agent identity and permissions, and auditability.
Implement AI cost management, including usage monitoring, budget controls, and cost-per-outcome reporting.
Lead enablement and change management through training and champion networks, and institutionalize proven AI practices and patterns across the organization.

Leadership

Recruit, develop, and retain engineering managers and senior technical talent, and own organizational design, performance management, and budget.
Partner with engineering, product, and business leaders as a peer. Report to the executive stakeholders on engineering productivity (including DORA metrics), AI adoption, cost, and business impact.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience and 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading platform or infrastructure organizations and 5+ years of management experience.
Demonstrated leadership of developer platform or developer productivity functions supporting hundreds of engineers, with measurable improvements in delivery speed and reliability.
Deep expertise in GitHub, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud platforms, and identity and access management (e.g., Okta).
Hands-on experience with frontier AI models (e.g., Claude, Codex), MCP, and agentic workflows, with sound judgment on their practical strengths and limitations.
Proven track record of leading internal AI adoption that delivered measurable productivity gains for engineering and non-engineering teams, including cost controls and monitoring.
Strong bias for action and ownership, balancing speed of delivery with sound governance while remaining close to technical decisions and demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority across a large organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare or life sciences, including HIPAA compliance and auditable development practices.
Experience securing agentic systems and establishing evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agents.
Experience with Kubernetes, ephemeral development environments, or sandboxed agent execution.
A customer-focused approach to internal platforms, with a record of building solutions that engineering and business teams readily adopt.

This role is eligible for Verily-sponsored immigration support.

jobs.title: Head of E/E Architecture, Connected Vehicles
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Connected Vehicle Engineering Director, the Head of E/E Architecture is the primary technical and strategic leader responsible for defining, evolving, and governing the next-generation Electrical/Electronic (E/E) systems and Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform across all BRP product lines.

In an environment where software and electronic architectures are core strategic differentiators for BRP products, you will lead the transition from legacy, flat distributed networks to a multi-product, domain-based central compute architecture. In collaboration with software, systems, integration, validation, cybersecurity, and product line teams, as well as global technology suppliers, you will shape BRP’s multi-year technological roadmap and build a world-class architecture and software engineering organization.

YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO

Define and execute the transition to a more centralized E/E architecture, integrating Infotainment, Connectivity, and ADAS using Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) principles.
Lead top-level platform design for next-generation vehicle E/E architectures, defining hardware topology, high-speed vehicle networks (Automotive Ethernet, TSN, CAN-FD), power wake-up/sleep strategies, and SOA service boundaries.
Drive vehicle-to-cloud and mobile ecosystem architectures to deliver reliable connectivity features in off-grid environments using smartphone proxying, local caching, and automated wireless handshakes.
Direct and enforce BRP’s 3-tier E/E Architecture Governance Model across all product lines using objective trade-off evaluation tools to eliminate technical debt and maximize component reuse.
Function as the technical lead and final approver for cybersecurity and functional safety, ensuring vehicle architectures comply with UN R155, CRA, ISO/SAE 21434, and ISO 26262 standards.
Lead the adoption of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies (Capella/SysML) and manage the New Technology Roadmap (NTR) for Connected Vehicle R&D in partnership with BRP’s CTA.

YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
10–15+ years of progressive engineering experience in automotive, powersports, off-highway, or aerospace E/E system design, with at least 5+ years in a technical leadership or managerial role.
A proven track record of delivering mass-production E/E architectures, central compute platforms, or complex embedded software systems from concept to vehicle launch.
Deep expertise in Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV), domain and zonal compute topologies, centralized compute SoCs (e.g., NXP, Qualcomm, Telechips), and hypervisor/virtualization technologies.
Strong proficiency in vehicle networking protocols (Automotive Ethernet, TSN, SOME/IP, DDS, CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, UDS).
Excellent executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex multi-domain technical concepts into clear proposals for executive leadership.
Demonstrated change management capabilities and strategic business acumen to align independent business units around shared platform architectures while balancing technical innovation against BOM cost and development speed.

Assets

Knowledge of AUTOSAR (Classic & Adaptive), POSIX RTOS (QNX/Linux), C/C++, Python, and modern embedded software development practices.
Direct experience with requirement management tools (Polarion, DOORS), MBSE tools (Capella, SysML), and RFLP frameworks.
Familiarity with automotive standards, including ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155/R156, and ASPICE delivery frameworks.
Experience evaluating and structuring supplier partnerships in global markets, particularly in Asia or EV/automotive ecosystems.
Demonstrated expertise in architecting hybrid connectivity solutions for powersports, off-highway, or automotive applications, leveraging mobile proxy mechanisms for off-grid navigation and deferred over-the-air updates.

ACKNOWLEDGING THE POWER OF DIVERSITY

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead!

For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

AT BRP, WHEN WE TALK ABOUT BENEFITS, WE GO ALL IN.

Let’s start with a strong foundation — You want it, we have it:

Annual bonus based on the company’s financial results
Generous paid time away
Pension plan
Collective saving opportunities
Industry leading healthcare fully paid by BRP

What About Some Feel Good Perks

Flexible work schedule
A summer schedule that varies by department and location
Holiday season shutdown
Educational resources
Discount on BRP products

WELCOME TO BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 17 000 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination: It’s about the journey.

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.

Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.

Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

ACAMS is the global leader in certification, training, and intelligence for anti-financial crime (AFC) professionals. ACAMS sets the standard for how organizations prevent, detect, and respond to money laundering, fraud and sanctions evasion. Trusted by 70% of the world's leading banks, as well as governmental and law enforcement agencies, and FinTechs, the organization has 125,000+ members across 200+ countries and territories. Its 65+ chapters and annual conferences connect AFC professionals across every major financial center. Learn more at acams.org.

Opportunity at a Glance

The Director of Digital owns the strategy, roadmap, and ongoing delivery of ACAMS.org and the broader ACAMS Digital Ecosystem. This is more than a website leadership role: our digital platform is a product in its own right, spanning discovery, trial, purchase, and renewal of certifications, training, membership, and subscription-based news and intelligence content. jobs.title: Associate Director, Pension Data Operations & Governance
jobs.description:
Our Company Background & Culture

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.

We’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.

We’ve Built And Nurtured a Culture That Is Intentionally Welcoming And Purposefully Rooted In Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, And Reconciliation (EDI&R). We Believe Diverse Teams, Perspectives, And Lived Experiences Contribute To Better Decisions And a Better Workplace. As UPP Celebrates Its Fifth Anniversary, We’re Proud To Be Recognized For Our Efforts

2026 Greater Toronto’s Top 100 Employers
2026 Canadian HR Award for Excellence in Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

THE ROLE

This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional individual to join a team of high performing professionals and make a significant impact.

As UPP builds its engagement model and implements a new Pension Administration Solution, the Associate Director, Pension Operations will play a dedicated role in engaging with the project team to build the go forward member and employer service experience and build out training strategy and artifacts. Once the project is complete, they will then transition to lead the teams accountable for service delivery.

Reporting to the Managing Director, Service Experience will build strong trusted relationships and communicate effectively with UPP’s members and employers in the support and development of UPP’s Pension services. This role will lead three lines of business: Member Transactions, pension payroll and Data, Reporting and Analytics. The role will provide leadership for pension data operations and governance, ensuring pension data is treated as a strategic asset with clear ownership, defined quality standards, effective controls, and transparent reporting across member, employer, payroll, actuarial, finance, technology, and regulatory processes.

In support of the Managing Director, Service Experience, this position will have a role in helping UPP meet our own strategic imperative to deliver world-class services to our members and employers.

This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (approximately two days per week in-office).

This job is for an existing vacancy.

Specific Accountabilities

Pension Data Governance Leadership

Establish and operationalize a pension data governance framework with clear accountabilities, data standards, data definitions, business rules, lineage, and critical data elements required to support accurate member records, contributions, service, earnings, calculations, payroll, reporting, and regulatory obligations.
Lead pension data quality management across key dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, reliability, relevance, access, coherence, and interpretability, with measurable thresholds, monitoring routines, issue management, and escalation protocols.
Build and oversee data controls for inbound employer data, member events, pension calculations, payroll interfaces, system conversions, reconciliations, reporting extracts, and downstream data uses.
Lead root-cause analysis and remediation of pension data issues, ensuring defects are prioritized based on member impact, financial risk, regulatory exposure, operational risk, and employer experience.
Develop governance routines, dashboards, and reporting that provide senior leadership and Board-level visibility into data quality, data risks, remediation progress, unresolved exceptions, and emerging trends.
Partner with Pension Operations, Employer Experience, Member Experience, Technology, Finance, Actuarial, Legal, Privacy, and Risk teams to ensure data governance practices support plan administration, member outcomes, compliance, and service excellence.
Champion a culture of data accountability by creating practical guidance, training, issue resolution routines, and continuous improvement practices that strengthen trust in pension data across the organization.
Act as a subject-matter expert of UPP plan provisions and calculation rules
Instill a service mindset in team members
Develop an expert internal team to build UPP’s member service offering and intellectual capital base
Exhibit an ability to listen, negotiate and communicate goals; share knowledge, experience, and responsibility with the team to achieve the highest standards of professionalism
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector
Other projects and activities, as required

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or other related disciplines
Possessing an MBA, C EBS, PPAC or any other relevant professional designation would be an asset
10+ years of progressive experience in pensions
Build strong cross-functional relationships
Demonstrated success working in a hands-on multi-faceted stakeholder environment
Ability to aspire confidence in a broad range of constituencies through a proactive, respectful, and accessible communication style
Demonstrated experience designing or operating data governance, data quality, data stewardship, or data management practices in a pension, financial services, insurance, benefits administration, or similarly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of how pension data supports contribution processing, service and earnings records, benefit calculations, payroll, actuarial valuations, financial controls, member communications, employer reporting, and regulatory filings.
Experience establishing data quality metrics, controls, reconciliations, issue logs, remediation plans, service-level expectations, and governance reporting for operational data sets.
Ability to translate complex data issues into clear business impacts, risk assessments, decision points, and executive-ready recommendations.

ATTRIBUTES

High degree of self-motivation and professionalism
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple client streams in a time sensitive manner
Excellent relationship building and conflict resolution skills
Demonstrated leadership abilities
Excellent interpersonal and verbal communication skills
A collaborative approach to understand and respond to organizational needs and partner with various organizational teams
High degree of professional ethics and integrity
Strong commercial and strategic judgment

Expected Compensation

The expected compensation for this role is a combination of base salary and variable incentive.

You may also be eligible for a variable incentive depending on organizational, divisional and personal performance. The final total compensation offered will vary depending on your skills, experience and other factors.

LIFE AT UPP

Do work that matters.
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

Stronger together.
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.

Grow every day.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on unique, once-in-a-career projects that maximize your skill set and probably teach you some new ones—at any stage in your career.

Benefits

Prioritize wellness.
At UPP, wellness takes many forms. Ultimately, it’s about ensuring our people are cared for in the ways that matter to them. Check out some highlights of our inclusive employee-focused benefits program including:

Defined benefit pension plan
Flexible hybrid work model
Paid time off – vacations, personal days and wellness days
Work remotely up to eight weeks/year
Comprehensive group benefits including medical, dental, vision, etc.
Extended paramedical and mental health service coverage
Health care and lifestyle spending accounts
Fertility treatments, paid parental leave, and gender affirmation coverage
Education Assistance program

UPP enthusiastically welcomes applications from all qualified applicants and especially invites people with lived experience as an Indigenous person, a person with a disability or as a member of another Human Rights Code protected group that faces barriers to employment to apply. Our goal is to create a barrier-free experience for every candidate throughout the recruitment process.

new_jobs.title: Director, Developer Platform and AI Transformation
new_jobs.description:
About Verily Health Inc.

At the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily Health transforms complex health data into trusted intelligence, enabling health solutions that are more personal, predictive, and precise.

Verily’s flagship Governed Health Intelligence platform, Verily Pre, enables healthcare organizations to responsibly govern, model, and securely activate their protected health data at scale, deploying intelligence with the scientific rigor, oversight, and auditability needed for healthcare.

Description

The Director of Developer Platform and AI Transformation will lead Verily’s developer platform and enterprise AI enablement strategy. In this role, you will own the tools and infrastructure that enable engineers to build and release software securely and efficiently, and you will drive the adoption of AI across engineering and business functions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cloud Engineering and Developer Platform, you will lead a high-performing organization of 15 engineers and managers. You will be accountable for developers productivity, AI enablement, and the return on Verily’s AI investments.

Responsibilities

Developer Platform

Own the end-to-end SDLC toolchain, including GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and build and release pipelines, along with foundational developer services such as identity and access management (Okta).
Manage the developer platform as an internal product, using developer research and productivity data to improve the developer experience, set priorities, and guide the roadmap.
Ensure the reliability, observability, and cost efficiency of CI/CD and core developer tooling against defined service-level objectives.
Partner with Security and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) teams to secure the software supply chain and maintain auditable pipelines that meet Verily’s regulatory requirements (such as FISMA and FedGov).
Integrate AI across the SDLC, including coding agents, code review, testing, and deployment, supported by the necessary security, privacy, and cost guardrails.

AI Transformation

Define and execute Verily’s enterprise AI enablement strategy and roadmap, and manage the portfolio of internal and third-party AI solutions, including build-versus-buy decisions.
Partner with operations, finance, legal, and product engineering leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, and lead the redesign of those workflows using AI agents.
Build and operate a shared AI harness encompassing agentic platform, MCP integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise knowledge graph.
Establish AI governance in partnership with Security, Privacy, Legal, and GRC, covering acceptable use, protected health information, agent identity and permissions, and auditability.
Implement AI cost management, including usage monitoring, budget controls, and cost-per-outcome reporting.
Lead enablement and change management through training and champion networks, and institutionalize proven AI practices and patterns across the organization.

Leadership

Recruit, develop, and retain engineering managers and senior technical talent, and own organizational design, performance management, and budget.
Partner with engineering, product, and business leaders as a peer. Report to the executive stakeholders on engineering productivity (including DORA metrics), AI adoption, cost, and business impact.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience and 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading platform or infrastructure organizations and 5+ years of management experience.
Demonstrated leadership of developer platform or developer productivity functions supporting hundreds of engineers, with measurable improvements in delivery speed and reliability.
Deep expertise in GitHub, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud platforms, and identity and access management (e.g., Okta).
Hands-on experience with frontier AI models (e.g., Claude, Codex), MCP, and agentic workflows, with sound judgment on their practical strengths and limitations.
Proven track record of leading internal AI adoption that delivered measurable productivity gains for engineering and non-engineering teams, including cost controls and monitoring.
Strong bias for action and ownership, balancing speed of delivery with sound governance while remaining close to technical decisions and demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority across a large organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare or life sciences, including HIPAA compliance and auditable development practices.
Experience securing agentic systems and establishing evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agents.
Experience with Kubernetes, ephemeral development environments, or sandboxed agent execution.
A customer-focused approach to internal platforms, with a record of building solutions that engineering and business teams readily adopt.

This role is eligible for Verily-sponsored immigration support.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $216,500 - 324,500 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus or benefits.
